NONE: › urine, or an act of urinating
› an expression used when you are slightly annoyed

example: There was piddle all over the floor.
One minute - I just need a piddle.
Oh piddle! I've broken another glass.
糟糕，我又打破了一個杯子！

NONE: 瑣碎的；無關緊要的，微不足道的
› a language that has developed from a mixture of two languages. It is used as a way of communicating by people who do not speak each other's languages.
（兩種語言混在一起的）混雜語言，洋涇浜語
› English, French, etc. when it is spoken in a simple way by someone who does not speak that language well

example: "He come here?" he asked in pidgin English.
「他來這裡？」他用洋涇浜英語問道。
